name: Instagram
description: Browse Instagram creators and Reels through a self-hosted real-browser backend. No third-party login.
author: 0x13A0F

settings.name: Load comment replies
settings.description: Fetch full reply threads on demand. Adds one request each time you expand a comment's replies. When off, only the few replies Instagram includes for free are shown.

settings.name: Cache duration
settings.description: Cache responses on the backend for this long so quickly re-opening pages is instant and Instagram is hit less (avoids rate-limits). Off = always fetch fresh.
